input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a tab-separated primer samplesheet, a primer FASTA, or a directory of primer FASTA files. Alternative to --primer_set (mutually exclusive) - required unless --primer_set or --build_references is given.
input.help_text: Provide a TSV samplesheet with primer, fwd, rev, min and max columns, a single .fa/.fasta/.fna primer FASTA, or a directory containing them. A file is read as FASTA or samplesheet based on its first non-blank line, not its extension. FASTA input requires --primer_min and --primer_max.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

teeliste.description: Target-taxa TSV used by the interactive Tea List and Primer Evaluation pages

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

build_references.description: Alternative workflow to install the references

install_taxdump.description: Install both the NCBI taxonomy dump and nucl_gb.accession2taxid during --build_references

primer_min.description: Global minimum amplicon length for --input primer FASTA input

primer_max.description: Global maximum amplicon length for --input primer FASTA input

genbank_taxid.description: Restrict the BLASTN-vs-core_nt search to this taxid; unrestricted (searches all of core_nt) if not set

dbs.description: A comma-separated list of pre-installed databases to benchmark against

taxid.description: Restrict --dbs/--custom_db to this taxid (and its descendants) before analysis, so only that taxon is analysed/checked

accession_blocklist.description: Path to accessions that should be removed after OBI-PCR parsing and excluded from every downstream analysis. Use one accession per line; blank lines and # comments are ignored, and matching is version-insensitive.

primer_set.description: A comma-separated list of named primer sets (from the bio-raum/FooDMe2 catalog) to use instead of --input

list_primers.description: List available primer sets (as JSON) and exit

reference_base.description: The base folder to which the references have been installed

taxdump.description: Path to a pre-installed NCBI taxdump directory. Overrides the default derived from --reference_base/--reference_version.

accession_taxonomy.description: Path to an accession2taxid/genbank2taxid mapping file. Overrides the default derived from --reference_base/--reference_version.

run_name.description: A descriptive name for this analysis run

taxon.description: A valid taxonomic identifier (e.g. 'Mammalia') to perform in-depth analysis to get the species coverage using ete

interactive.description: Launch the Streamlit results dashboard (port 8501) after the run completes

mask.description: Mask primer-binding regions in each amplicon

read_length.description: Expected read length (default 400 for single end, 150 otherwise)

custom_db.description: A custom database formatted with crabs 1.0.7 and above

cluster_id.description: VSEARCH --cluster_fast identity threshold used to group barcode sequences (set with --cluster_id)

dereplicate_amplicons.description: Dereplicate identical post-PCR amplicons before VSEARCH clustering

consensus_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of taxonomically assigned accessions in a cluster that must support a consensus assignment

db_filter_pattern.description: Regex pattern for removing unwanted headers from selected databases

db_filter_min_length.description: Minimum sequence length for database filtering. Must be used together with db_filter_max_length

db_filter_max_length.description: Maximum sequence length for database filtering. Must be used together with db_filter_min_length

db_filter_max_n.description: Maximum number of ambiguous bases allowed per sequence. Only applied when length filter is active

obipcr_mismatches.description: Number of mismatches allowed for obipcr

obipcr_fixed_3prime.description: Number of 3'-terminal bases of each primer that must match without mismatch, as in a real PCR. Applied by appending '#' to those bases in the obipcr primer. 0 disables the clamp

db_filter.description: Apply header and sequence filtering to every selected database
